radiology_report:
Tergooi MC
Department of Radiology
Date: 15 Feb 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: Re-evaluation of known prostate cancer. PSA 15.0 ng/mL, PI-RADS 5.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume: 63.76 mL. PSA density 0.24 ng/mL/mL.
T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal, markedly hypointense lesion within the peripheral zone of the right posterolateral base, measuring approximately 18 mm in maximum diameter. On diffusion-weighted imaging, the lesion exhibits restricted diffusion with high signal intensity and corresponding low ADC values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences show early, intense enhancement of the lesion relative to the surrounding gland. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified on the current imaging.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral zone. Clinical stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.87020874.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. van den Berg (GP)
previous_notes.text: The patient attended for routine monitoring of his prostate health. His PSA was measured at 9.8 ng/mL, representing a significant rise from the 6.4 ng/mL recorded in July 2023. Given the accelerating PSA velocity and the prior biopsy findings, a repeat imaging assessment was scheduled to guide further management.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. van den Berg (GP)
previous_notes.text: The patient presented with a PSA of 6.4 ng/mL, which had risen from 4.2 ng/mL in October 2022. He reported no new lower urinary tract symptoms. A transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy was performed during this period, which confirmed the presence of adenocarcinoma. He was referred to urology for specialist review and discussion of treatment options.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1: Microscopic examination of the prostate tissue cores reveals adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 4+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 3. The growth pattern is characterized by mostly fused tubules and cribriform and glomeruloid tubules. A cribriform pattern is present. Perineural invasion is not identified. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, right. 

Summary: The histological findings across the biopsy timepoints demonstrate a stable grade profile with persistent ISUP grade group 3 disease and high-risk architectural features.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 4.
